description: Quarterly Council audit of tsukuroi. Four structural zero-counters encode the actor's constitutional ceiling: autonomousMergeCount (G4), exploitArtifactCount (G5), outOfScopeWriteCount (G6), platformHeldKeyCount (G8). Any nonzero value is a critical violation ⇒ cell halt + chigiri.disputeMediation (ADR-2605262700) + Bonsai seed-tier prune (ADR-2605091800, G13). R0 = schema skeleton; R1 = additionalProperties=false + required-field enforcement.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of review emit.

attestingCouncilDids.description: Council Lv6+ seat DIDs attesting the review (≥3).

autonomousMergeCount.description: G4: count of merges/deploys tsukuroi performed itself. MUST be 0 (propose-only). Nonzero ⇒ critical violation.

exploitArtifactCount.description: G5: count of exploit/PoC/offensive artifacts generated. MUST be 0 (defensive-only, §2(a)). Nonzero ⇒ critical violation.

outOfScopeWriteCount.description: G6: count of writes outside mandate.allowedPaths. MUST be 0. Nonzero ⇒ critical violation.

platformHeldKeyCount.description: G8: count of platform-held master/merge credentials tsukuroi held. MUST be 0 (ADR-2605231525). Nonzero ⇒ critical violation.

mandatesActive.description: Number of active RemediationMandates in the period.

proposalsSubmitted.description: Number of patch proposals submitted in the period.

remediationsClosed.description: Number of closures (ownerMerged + akumaReprobePass) in the period.

violationDisputeCids.description: If any zero-counter was nonzero, the chigiri.disputeMediation record CIDs opened.
